title: Demand forecast cockpit
question: How much will each item sell over the next weeks, and is the order on track?
story: The next weeks need {next_forecast} units; {at_risk_n} items carry a forecast error above the naive benchmark.
questions: Which items have the widest forecast range next month?
Where does the forecast run above capacity?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.current_order, o.recommended_order, o.as_of_date, i.category, i.region, i.channel FROM main.supply.demand_out AS o JOIN main.supply.items AS i ON i.item_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: series
datasets.sql: SELECT s.series_id, i.item_label AS series_label, s.period, s.actual, s.forecast, s.lower, s.upper, s.is_future, s.method, s.backtest_mase, i.category, i.region, i.channel FROM main.supply.demand_out__series AS s JOIN main.supply.items AS i ON i.item_id = s.series_id

datasets.name: outlook
datasets.sql: SELECT s.period, s.forecast, s.upper, c.capacity, i.category, i.region, i.channel FROM main.supply.demand_out__series AS s JOIN main.supply.items AS i ON i.item_id = s.series_id JOIN main.supply.capacity AS c ON c.period = s.period AND c.region = i.region

datasets.name: at_risk
datasets.sql: SELECT i.item_label AS series_label, i.category, i.region, i.channel, MAX(s.backtest_mase) AS backtest_mase, SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_future THEN s.upper - s.forecast END) AS upside, SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_future THEN s.forecast END) AS next_forecast FROM main.supply.demand_out__series AS s JOIN main.supply.items AS i ON i.item_id = s.series_id GROUP BY i.item_label, i.category, i.region, i.channel HAVING MAX(s.backtest_mase) > 1 OR SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_future THEN s.upper - s.forecast END) > 0

kpis.label: Forecast, next weeks
kpis.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_future THEN forecast END)

charts.title: Demand with its forecast range
charts.hint: History, then the forecast with its 80% range.
charts.so_what: Order to the forecast line; hold safety stock for the top of the band.

charts.title: Forecast against capacity
charts.hint: Where the top of the range runs above what we can supply.
charts.so_what: Weeks where the high line crosses capacity need extra supply booked now.

charts.title: Forecast error by item
charts.hint: Backtest error against a naive forecast; above 1 is worse than naive.
charts.so_what: Review the items above 1 before you trust their order.

tables.title: Items at risk
tables.hint: Items whose forecast is weak or whose range runs high.
tables.so_what: Check these items first: their order is the least certain.

plan.title: Order plan
plan.hint: The suggested order for each item from the forecast. Accept it, or override it with a reason.

records.title: Items to order
records.hint: Items from the latest run, ranked by the stock at risk.
records.label: entity_label
